_about: Third-party venue addresses this repo integrates against on chain 4663.
Every entry below was resolved on-chain, not copied from vendor docs.
WARNING - the canonical Uniswap V3 mainnet addresses are NOT the Uniswap
deployment on this chain, and they are not empty either. As of 2026-08-04,
each hold ~2110 bytes of an unrelated contract that answers no Uniswap
selector. A code-presence assertion (`code.length != 0`) PASSES on both.
Any deploy-time guard must assert identity - see `verification` per entry.

MorphoBlue.verification: 15582 bytes of code; struct layout pinned byte-identical to the vendored src/vendor/morpho/IMorpho.sol in MorphoSupplyMainnetFork.t.sol.

UniswapV3Factory.verification: feeAmountTickSpacing(100) == 1; getPool(WETH, USDG, 100) round-trips to 0x52e65B17fB6E5BA00Ed806f37Afcd2DaA50271Ca, whose own factory() returns this address.

UniswapV3NonfungiblePositionManager.verification: 24384 bytes of code; name() == "Uniswap V3 Positions NFT-V1", symbol() == "UNI-V3-POS", factory() == UniswapV3Factory above, WETH9() == WETH below. Discovered from the owner topic of a Mint log on the USDG/WETH 0.01% pool rather than from a published address list.

SushiLaunchpadV1.verification: Verified source on robinhoodchain.blockscout.com as SushiLaunchpad (solc v0.8.36); 2366 TokenLaunched events. Identity, not presence: WETH() == WETH below, v3Factory() == SushiV3Factory below, positionManager() == SushiV3NonfungiblePositionManager below. Live params read 2026-08-28: launchFee() == 5e14 wei, protocolReserveBps() == 300, defaultSushiFeeBps() == 3000, owner() == 0x6fA4080b70eed82Cf48570DDE705026905a64657. quoteTokenPriceFeed(WOOD) == address(0) at that date -- WOOD-paired launches revert UnsupportedQuoteToken until the venue owner registers a WOOD/USD aggregator.

SushiV3Factory.verification: feeAmountTickSpacing(10000) == 200 (the 1% tier the launchpad mints into). Round-trip closed: getPool(WOOD, WETH, 3000) == WoodWethSushiV3Pool below, whose own factory() returns this address. Distinct from UniswapV3Factory above -- the two venues do NOT share a factory on this chain.

SushiV3NonfungiblePositionManager.verification: name() == "SushiSwap V3 Positions NFT-V1", symbol() == "SUSHI-V3-POS", factory() == SushiV3Factory above, WETH9() == WETH below. Holds every launchpad LP position -- the launch creator never custodies one.

WoodWethSushiV3Pool.verification: fee() == 3000, factory() == SushiV3Factory above, liquidity() == 2.128e22 read 2026-08-28. The live WOOD/WETH venue behind the SHARE/WOOD pairing; also the only on-chain WOOD price source, and thin enough (~$437k) that the protocol admits its TWAP only under the min() ceiling in WoodTwapOracle.
